provenance.selection_method: Metric subject: first ascending source slug whose largest nonborrowed key is a documented extra metric, exceeds each named-chain value and remains below total. Family: first descending source parent ID with at least two positive children and a multichain child.
provenance.scope: Genuine selected source fields, not complete wire bodies. All measured numbers and source dates unchanged. Isolated map projections in tests select existing keys only, not claimed separately published responses. Offline transport uses these captures; primary503 is an injected fault, never a live-outage claim.
